hub.sub: A structured way for agencies, consultancies and networks to resell defined MMC services under their own brand.

answer.label: In short
answer.lead: A white-label reseller programme lets a partner sell defined MMC services under its own brand. You choose the services, set your own client pricing and own the relationship; MMC delivers to a written scope and provides sales support material. It suits agencies, consultancies and networks that want repeatable packages.

stages.why: If you cannot describe the package in a line, your sales team cannot sell it twice the same way.
stages.does: We provide defined packages with a written scope and sales material, which you can rename and position.

stages.breaks: Writing a custom scope for every client.
stages.why: Every bespoke scope is a new risk and a new delay before the work can start.
stages.does: Packages carry a written scope you can reuse. Changes are quoted separately, so the base stays clean.

stages.k: Onboard the same way each time
stages.why: Missing logins and unclear goals slow every project, and you end up chasing information.
stages.does: One intake and one client code per client, with a checklist for what we need from you.

stages.why: A client asks for an update and you have to ask us before you can answer.
stages.does: A delivery tracker against the written scope, with a named contact on our side.

stages.why: A package that sold well can still lose money if the cost of delivery was not clear when you priced it.
stages.does: You set the client price, you know our delivery cost under the agreement, and your margin is visible per package.
